audioNote.markdown:
Welcome to Sessionboard!
In this quick video, we’ll walk you through how to create and assign resources—also known as Wiki Pages—to a portal. Wiki Pages are a great way to share important information with your event contacts, such as the event address, parking instructions, or dress code. These resources can be accessed through the portal at any time.

audioNote.markdown: After creating your wiki page, be sure to assign it to the appropriate portal so your contacts can view it. To do this, click Portals at the top of the page to return to the portal home.

steps.title: Access Portals

audioNote.markdown: Select the ellipses to the right of the portal the task should be assigned to and select Edit Tasks from the action list.

audioNote.markdown: In the pop-up, check the box next to the page you want to assign to your portal, then click "Add Selected" in the bottom right corner.
